name: require-project-context-double-identity
body: The project binding resolves the repo identity twice per guarded act, once in require_project_context and once inside require_project, and adds no unit test at this tier because the binding is e2e-covered; the bound refusal is registry-aware, naming the row's worktree and branch beside the caller's current branch and one `apg project start` fix line. Fold the two identity walks into one if the guard becomes hot.
